subject: Approval requested: AtlasWorks performance vignette & logo use
messages:
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: sophia.lopez@atlasworks.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short performance vignette + logo usage for Q2 case highlight

Hi Sophia,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week—AtlasWorks' throughput improvements on the anomaly-detection pipeline are a really compelling outcome. Marketing here at Redwood is putting together a short "performance vignette" we hope to publish on the site and use in a sales one-pager.

Attached is a one-page excerpt draft (case_excerpt_draft_v1.docx) that pulls the metrics we discussed and a suggested short quote attribution. We'd like to include the AtlasWorks logo on the collateral and request formal permission to use the logo and the quote. High-level asks: 
- Approval to use the AtlasWorks logo (horizontal PNG & full-color SVG).
- Confirmation on the exact quote wording (we've proposed a 35–40 word quote).
- Any logo usage constraints (colors, clear space, tagline rules).

If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) is our marketing lead and can take the draft through design and legal review. If you can loop in legal or provide the brand guidelines file, that would speed things up.

Target timing: we'd love to publish the vignette the week of Aug 24 if possible. Can you confirm by EOD Mon (Aug 17)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Hi Karthik — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. I shared the draft with legal and our product team (cc'd). Initial reaction is positive; a couple of notes from product on phrasing and a legal request for our standard logo-use attachment and a short usage clause.

Legal (legal@atlasworks.com) asked that we provide:
- A copy of the collateral mock (PDF or docx) clearly showing logo placement.
- A sentence confirming the customer quote is approved by AtlasWorks comms before publish.
- A usage window: we typically approve web + sales collateral for 18 months, then re-review.

I'll send the brand guidelines PDF and the logo files in a follow-up email, and we'll aim to get a signed usage note back to you by Aug 17. If Marissa can produce a PDF mock with the logo placement by EOD tomorrow that will help speed the process.

Best,
Sophia Lopez
Head of Marketing | AtlasWorks

Quick notes on the proposed quote: we've tightened the wording to 34 words to match the approved length for the website. I'll paste both versions below so legal can pick.

Proposed quote (edit): "With Redwood Inference we cut inference cost per query by 62% and reduced median latency from 340ms to 110ms—enabling real-time anomaly detection at scale."

Original (from the draft): "Redwood helped us reduce cost and improve latency so we could run our anomaly detector in production."

Let us know which you prefer and any logo constraints; if we can get the usage note by Aug 17 we will proceed to design and scheduling.

On Mon, Aug 16, 2026 at 08:27, marissa.cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks Sophia — I've exported the attached PDF mock with the logo placed in two layouts (header and callout).

Hello all,

We reviewed the mock and the proposed quote. AtlasWorks can approve the publication subject to the following simple usage terms (please confirm acceptance):
1) Limited license: Redwood is granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use AtlasWorks' name, logo, and the approved quote in the collateral identified (website vignette, sales one-pager) for a period of 18 months from the publication date.
2) Attribution: Include the attribution line exactly as: "AtlasWorks Inc." below the quote.
3) No implication of endorsement beyond the case vignette.
4) Right to withdraw: AtlasWorks reserves the right to withdraw permission with 30 days' notice; Redwood will remove the logo from future web pages and sales materials within a commercially reasonable period.

We attach the AtlasWorks_Logo_Guidelines.pdf and the logo pack. If you can produce a short one-paragraph release covering use of the quote and logo with the attribution line, we can have an authorized signatory confirm by DocuSign.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
General Counsel (on behalf of AtlasWorks legal)
legal@atlasworks.com

Attachments referenced: AtlasWorks_Logo_Guidelines.pdf

Hi Sophia / Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear terms. Redwood accepts the usage terms as written.

Per request, Marissa has prepared the short release paragraph and attached the PDF mock with the exact attribution line. We're happy to proceed to DocuSign; linking the proposed envelope here: https://www.docusign.net/link/aw-logo-release

Proposed release paragraph (for signature):
"AtlasWorks Inc. grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the AtlasWorks name, logo, and the approved quote in the specified website vignette and sales collateral for a period of 18 months from the publication date, with attribution shown as \"AtlasWorks Inc.\". This permission is subject to the AtlasWorks Logo Guidelines and may be withdrawn with 30 days' notice."

Sophia — can you confirm who should sign on AtlasWorks' side? Once I have the signatory I will route the DocuSign envelope for signature.
